text:
arjun: FYI seeing spike in request timeouts from hosted inference, 5xxs up ~4x over last 3m. Thinking about flipping emergency toggle for 'inference-prefetch' for the canary cohort (10%) while we investigate. who is authorized to cut this?

maya: if we can confirm impact on user-facing workflows (sessions dropping), i'm +1. but we need the exact command and audit details before anyone flips.

samir: +1 to audit. who will own the rollback if downstream degrades?

emily: eng-platform-oncall should own the flip + quick smoke. sre-oncall to own watch & rollback steps.

sre-oncall: i can watch. to be clear: only eng-platform-oncall or a designated release manager should execute the toggle. please add a reason and ticket id in the command.

eng-platform-oncall: i can flip if we decide. propose target: disable prefetch for canary only (flag: inference.prefetch.canary) not global.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Any feature flag change must include `--reason` and `--ticket`. Changes are recorded to /audit/feature-flips and will create an entry in the deployment changelog.

arjun: ok, playbook suggestion: 1) eng-platform-oncall flips canary flag off 2) wait 60s for canary sync 3) quick smoke (2 requests) 4) if errors drop, roll to 50% then monitor 10m. if not, revert. also open a pager if error rate > 3x baseline after flip.

maya: command i'd run (copy/paste):

```
# disable canary prefetch and add audit metadata
rctl feature toggle --flag inference.prefetch.canary --off --actor "eng-platform-oncall" --reason "spike-5xx-1765432100" --ticket INF-4231
```

samir: pls also tag the region: `--scope region=us-west-2` (we only saw issues there).

eng-platform-oncall: ack. i'll run the command if we greenlight. anyone object to canary-only toggle? :eyes:

emily: no objections. confirm we'll not touch global flag.

sre-oncall: checklist before flip: 
- confirm pager/subs are quiet on other infra alerts
- snapshot current error-rate and 95th latency (screenshot)
- have rollback command ready (rctl feature toggle --flag inference.prefetch.canary --on ...)
- create short note in #incidents with links to logs

arjun: adding: immediately tag the audit log with the incident id and the person who executed it. if eng-platform-oncall flips, they should post in this thread with the exact command output (or screenshot).

oncall-bot: Audit reminder: audit entries are immutable. If you need to amend, file INF-4231 with follow-up and reference the flip id.

eng-platform-oncall: i'm going to flip now. will post output.

eng-platform-oncall: ran:
```
> rctl feature toggle --flag inference.prefetch.canary --off --actor "eng-platform-oncall" --reason "spike-5xx-1765432100" --ticket INF-4231 --scope region=us-west-2
Success: feature inference.prefetch.canary set to OFF (scope: region=us-west-2)
flip_id: ff_2026_1765432100_001
```

sre-oncall: got it. watching metrics. currently 5xx rate went from 4.1% -> 1.8% after ~45s. latency 95p down ~120ms.

emily: good signal. keep monitoring 10m, then decide next step.

maya: please update INF-4231 with the flip_id and paste a link to the logs you used for assessment.

eng-platform-oncall: added flip_id and links to logs in INF-4231. postflip note: will keep canary off while we root cause. will coordinate a config rollback if necessary.

arjun: thanks all. action items: eng-ml to debug prefetch path in parallel, eng-platform to track rollout windows, sre to handle stability watch. we'll do a debrief after 24h.

samir: one more ops note: we should add the following to the emergency playbook to avoid confusion next time: a single canonical command template, a required post action (ticket + flip_id), and a two-person approval for global flips. filing follow-up INF-4232.

emily: +1. thanks everyone. :team-heart:
